in_sanskrit.name: दक्षेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who bestows blessings and prosperity through the act of sacrifice. A name of Lord Shiva.

in_hindi.name: दक्षेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: The bestower of wealth and prosperity. A name of Lord Shiva.

in_tamil.name: தக்ஷேஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who receives the offerings made in the sacrificial fire.

in_marathi.name: Dakshesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Sacrifice
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dakshesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dakshesh is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Daksh’, meaning ‘dexterous’ or ‘skilled’. This name is given to a child born on the auspicious occasion of Dussehra, celebrating the victory of good over evil. The name Dakshesh symbolizes the spirit of sacrifice and dedication to one's duties.
